Resolves #20990

The merge comment counted zero earlier merges for every returning outside author. Its search ended in a timestamp with a `+00:00` offset, the `+` reached GitHub's search as a space, and the search then looked for the word `00:00`. The stamp now ends in `Z`, the run logs the count it read, and the spec refuses a `+` in any search query.

Evidence: L3 (two dry runs of the workflow dispatched from this branch under the job's own token, before and after) → L3 required (AC-1). Residual: AC-5 is post-merge.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 a dry run from the fix branch logs three merges before #20981 | outside-CI: run [43664482038](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/43664482038) at `fd46c5d217`: "bfs2021 had 3 merged before #20981." Before the fix, on the same branch with only log lines added: run [43664300061](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/43664300061) counts 0 for the `+00:00` form and 3 for the `Z` form. |
| AC-2 the spec pins the `Z` form and refuses a `+` | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/contributorStanding.spec.mjs`, "a merged outside pull request is commented on once, from a count that never waits for the index" |
| AC-3 the run logs the count | CI-covered: the same test reads the info line; outside-CI: the line in run 43664482038 |
| AC-4 #20981 carries a correction | outside-CI: the maintainer reply on #20981 (4 merged, one more to the next rung) |
| AC-5 the next returning outside merge shows the right count | Post-Merge Validation |

## Deltas from ticket

The ticket first suspected the `org:` qualifier under the job's token and a second victim, the claim limit. The first dry run ([43664164287](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/43664164287)) refuted the suspect, the second showed the claim responder's query counting right, and the ticket body was corrected before this fix was written. The fix is therefore two lines in one workflow, not a shared query builder.

## Test Evidence

- Dry runs under the job's token: 43664164287 (every scoped form 0, unscoped 50), 43664300061 (`+00:00` 0, `Z` 3, the claim responder's query 4), 43664482038 (the fixed workflow: 3).
- By hand, the same queries: 3 with `+00:00` properly encoded, 0 scoped and 50 unscoped with a space in its place. The job's numbers are the space's numbers.
- Not shown by any of this: where the `+` is lost, in the client or at the API. The fix does not depend on it.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The next outside merge by an account with earlier merges shows the right standing; its run is read and recorded on #20892.
